claim_one_line: THE FULL SUITE FOUND FIVE RED LOCKS THAT 94 TARGETED TESTS DID NOT, AND THIS IS THE THIRD INSTANCE OF THE MECHANISM REVIEW 42 NAMED AND B1041 RECORDED AS HAVING ALREADY RECURRED. Two arcs banked green -- B1047 on 88 targeted tests, B1048 on 94, both with 28 gates green -- and the first full suite to run to completion on an UNCONTENDED box (4074 tests, 48 minutes) returned FIVE failures: two in test_b1037_band_dispositions RED SINCE B1043 (five arcs), one in test_b967_retraction_sweep on B1048's OWN FINDINGS, and two cascades. GATES ARE FAST AND DO NOT COVER WHAT THE LOCKS COVER, and a suite nobody runs to completion hides red locks at HEAD. TWO DISTINCT GENERAL DEFECTS, BOTH REPAIRED. DEFECT A, THE PER-LINE EXCLUSION IDIOM IS DEFEATED BY MARKDOWN WRAPPING: four arcs independently wrote the same idiom -- to measure a gap without counting your own rows, drop every LINE naming this arc or a later one -- and PROSE WRAPS while the idiom does not. B1043's ladder bullet puts the AUTHOR TOKEN (B1043) on one line and the CITATION (B141) on the next, so the filter drops the first and keeps the second and B141 READS AS CURATED BY NOBODY; B1037's band count fell 37 to 36 and its lock went red AT B1043 and stayed red for five arcs. THE SIBLING SWEEP -- the rule ERROR_LEDGER gained one arc ago, 'the repair is not complete until the FILE is swept', applied at the first opportunity -- found B1032 carries the identical defect and is GREEN ONLY BY LUCK, since it counts B885/B889/B890/B891 and not the orphaned B141/B564. THE COUNT IS TWO OF FOUR, NOT THREE: this arc's draft said three and ITS OWN CHECK CORRECTED IT, because B1031's predicate targets the string '**X33**' while the bullet reads '**X33 (three generations)**', and B1048's exclusion window starts after B1043 -- claiming three would have been E11, the overextended record, INSIDE THE ARC ABOUT LATENT DEFECTS. law_siblings.py uses the same idiom and is genuinely unaffected because its targets are single-line headlines, which was checked rather than assumed. All four consumers now share ONE implementation, scripts/checks/md_blocks.py, which NAMES ITS FOUR CONSUMERS IN ITS OWN DOCSTRING because B1035's finding was that shared code filed as a research arc becomes a shadow library; this one lives in scripts/checks/ with the other instruments and declares who imports it. The idiom was replaced everywhere, including where it happens not to bite. DEFECT B, THE RETRACTION SWEEP COULD NOT SEE THE ARC THAT WAS RUNNING IT: retraction_sweep._tracked_md() used `git ls-files *.md`, COMMITTED FILES ONLY, so a new arc's own FINDINGS.md was invisible to the sweep that arc ran and its violations first appeared in the NEXT run, AFTER BANKING. That is exactly how B1048 shipped two live uses of the two phrases IT HAD JUST REGISTERED -- its own sweep said clean, its own gate run said 28 green, and neither could have caught it. Repaired with `-co --exclude-standard`, which shows the sweep the working tree an author is about to bank while still honouring .gitignore. THIS IS A GENERAL SHAPE, NOT A ONE-OFF: any instrument that enumerates through git ls-files is blind to the work being done, and the others are worth checking. AND ONE MEASUREMENT CORRECTED: THE SUITE IS 48 MINUTES, NOT 81. The 81 recorded in BANKING_PROTOCOL at B1041 was measured WHILE TWO SUITE RUNS COMPETED for the same box -- and both of those runs were worthless anyway, because the working tree changed underneath them while they ran. Three lines added to the protocol row: A RUN AGAINST A MOVING TREE DISCHARGES NOTHING EITHER, so start it against a COMMITTED tree and stop editing until it lands or the run is a partial run wearing a complete run's exit code; the measured uncontended figure of 48 minutes over 4074 tests; and TARGETED RUNS DO NOT SUBSTITUTE, MEASURED -- 88 and 94 targeted tests with 28 gates green, five failures on the next full suite, because a targeted run tests what you THOUGHT you touched. 24 checks; 7 locks; 28 gates green; Gate 5 untouched; nothing to CLAIMS.md; no mathematics asserted or disturbed.
